projects.description: Project for managing reports for Crédit Agricole sales representatives, allowing them to manage their commercial activity reports and capitalize on their prospecting. Organization by application unit, very sectorized. Addition of many features to facilitate the sales representative's work. Front end with native technologies and Java Spring Boot back end. Implementation of ELK dashboard to create business indicators. Agile project with 4 to 6 developers, 2 business analysts and a product owner.

Business context around stock market and portfolio management. Existing project with Java JEE and Springboot as well as ergonomic redesign project in Angular 18 and mobile application. Very dense but very interesting business context with tribe-based organization, projects are V-cycle but a transition to Agile is desired and now effective.

Maintenance, evolution and corrective work on the SNCF incident reporting form. Application with strong ergonomic issues as users are stressed, work at night and are not IT professionals. The interface allows audio or textual entry of incidents on lines to display upcoming interruptions or slowdowns at stations, on board trains or on networks. Complete redesign on a one-page application. Feasibility study to migrate from AngularJS to Angular 16. Agile project with 2-6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.

Development of an application for display recognition in train stations and onboard trains. In parallel, work as a big data developer on the monitoring component of SNCF applications using ELK. The objective is to provide both operational and technical indicators. Use of Google Analytics with a .NET component to create additional indicators such as traffic on SNCF media. Development of non-native plugins on Kibana. Agile project in a team of 4 to 6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.

Development of a JHipster application with learning of versioning basics. The objective is to set up an internal gaming tournament application as part of corporate life. Developer intern in the innovation department.
